annotations.title: Tax disputes: court fee and type of procedure

description: Court fee for a lawsuit, appeal or cassation in an administrative tax case (Law of Ukraine «On Court Fee», subsistence minimum of the year), the Електронний суд coefficient, exemptions, whether a reduction is possible (fee above 5% of last year's income), and whether the case goes in simplified or general procedure.

annual_income_uah.description: Plaintiff's income for the previous year, UAH (for the 5% reduction rule).

claim_filed_on.description: For appeal / cassation: date the lawsuit was filed (YYYY-MM-DD).

fop_business.description: nonproperty: concerns the sole proprietor's business.

e_court.description: Filed via Електронний суд (coefficient 0.8). Default true.

exemption.description: Statutory exemption, if the user has one.

filed_on.description: Filing date. Default: today in Kyiv (YYYY-MM-DD).

jurisdiction.description: State whose procedure applies. Only "ua" (Ukraine) for now.
